description: NaRh(NO₂)₆(NH₄)₂ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3 space group. The structure consists of eight NH₄ clusters inside a NaRh(NO₂)₆ framework. In each NH₄ cluster, N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the NaRh(NO₂)₆ framework, Na is bonded in a cuboctahedral geometry to twelve equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Rh is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Rh-N bond lengths are 2.10 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Rh and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom.
